identificationModule.briefTitle: Study of NPC-08 is to Treat for Newly-Diagnosed Malignant Glioma and Recurrent Glioblastoma Multiforme
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase 1/2, Multicenter, Non-Randomized, Open Label Clinical Trial of NPC-08 Implant in Patients Undergoing Surgery for Newly-Diagnosed Malignant Glioma and Recurrent Glioblastoma Multiforme.

descriptionModule.briefSummary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate whether NPC-08 is safety and efficacy in the treatment of newly-diagnosed malignant glioma and recurrent glioblastoma multiforme.
